findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms force you to wait up to 90 days to receive your money, which can severely strain your business cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a small adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause ("Invoices are payable Net 90."), waiting up to 90 days can severely strain business cash flow, so I propose modifying the agreement so that Invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you for your time.
